name: adanvil
description: Agentic video ad editor: turns your brand's footage into ready-to-run 9:16 ads. Needs ffmpeg 6.1 or newer installed on your computer.

tools.name: ad_score
tools.description: Score a rendered ad out of 100 for creative quality, with findings to fix.

tools.name: brand_get
tools.description: Read the current brand profile and brief.

tools.name: brand_onboard
tools.description: Run brand onboarding step one or two.

tools.name: caption_preview
tools.description: Render a caption or comment over a real 9:16 frame.

tools.name: compare_pair
tools.description: Measure how different a before and an after look, to rank candidate pairs.

tools.name: editing_guide
tools.description: Return the editing doctrine for footage, copy, rendering and QC.

tools.name: end_card
tools.description: Compose a clean end card image from a real product photo.

tools.name: frame_view
tools.description: Extract one full-resolution frame from a project video or image.

tools.name: job_status
tools.description: Read a queued, running, completed or failed render, batch, voice, index or refine job.

tools.name: library_annotate
tools.description: Merge annotations into one catalogue entry.

tools.name: library_index
tools.description: Index or refresh media under a project-relative folder or file.

tools.name: library_overview
tools.description: Overview of the footage folders without indexing, plus a mosaic.

tools.name: library_search
tools.description: Search indexed footage using annotations and technical metadata.

tools.name: library_view
tools.description: Return one catalogue entry and its contact sheet.

tools.name: music_beats
tools.description: Beat times of a music track, as it will play in the ad.

tools.name: music_fetch
tools.description: Download a track from music_search into music/, with its licence.

tools.name: music_generate
tools.description: Make an instrumental track locally (optional ACE-Step environment), as a job.

tools.name: music_profile
tools.description: Tempo, loudness and energy of the music tracks, to match a reference.

tools.name: music_search
tools.description: Find music whose licence lets an ad use it (commercial use and modification).

tools.name: project_init
tools.description: Create an AdAnvil project skeleton.

tools.name: project_read_text
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 project text file using the project's safe path rules.

tools.name: qc_run
tools.description: Run technical QC on a rendered project-relative video.

tools.name: recipe_get
tools.description: Return one complete recipe, including rules and example.

tools.name: recipe_list
tools.description: List available ad recipes with purpose and duration.

tools.name: reference_breakdown
tools.description: Save the agent's shot-by-shot breakdown of a decoded reference.

tools.name: reference_decode
tools.description: Decode a reference video into shots, pacing, text, speech and sheets.

tools.name: render_batch
tools.description: Queue ONE background job that renders several storyboards in order.

tools.name: render_formats
tools.description: Render one storyboard in several formats: 9:16, 4:5, 1:1.

tools.name: render_start
tools.description: Validate and queue a background render.

tools.name: sfx_list
tools.description: List the sound effects of the project's sfx/ folder, and build the pack.

tools.name: speech_refine
tools.description: Transcribe chosen clips again with a stronger model and replace their words.

tools.name: speech_takes
tools.description: Pick the best take of each line across several recordings of a script.

tools.name: speech_view
tools.description: Read the speech of one indexed clip and get safe cuts for it.

tools.name: storyboard_patch
tools.description: Edit a saved storyboard in place: changes is a list of {path, value}.

tools.name: storyboard_save
tools.description: Save a storyboard in the project as storyboards/<name>.json and return its path.

tools.name: storyboard_schema
tools.description: Return the JSON Schema for Storyboard v1.

tools.name: storyboard_snap
tools.description: Move the cuts of a storyboard onto the beats of its music.

tools.name: storyboard_validate
tools.description: Validate a storyboard object or project-relative JSON file.

tools.name: timeline_export
tools.description: Export a storyboard as an editable timeline for DaVinci Resolve or Premiere Pro.

tools.name: variants_build
tools.description: Build the matrix of variants of one storyboard: hooks x bodies x calls to action.

tools.name: vision_setup
tools.description: Install the optional vision environment (once, several minutes, about 2.5 GB).

tools.name: voice_generate
tools.description: Queue a checked voice-over generation job.

tools.name: voice_view
tools.description: Read a voice manifest and suggest final-timeline shot boundaries.

projects_folder.title: Projects folder
projects_folder.description: Folder where AdAnvil keeps your ad projects (footage, brand, renders).

freesound_api_key.title: Freesound API key (optional)
freesound_api_key.description: Adds Freesound to the music search. Leave empty to use Openverse only.
